paragraphs.text: Present is an acorn creature type used for face-down creatures, which are usually wrapped .

Presents look like creatures of other recognizable types, except they are completely covered or enclosed in paper or other wrapping materials. They seem to be created by sending a creature through some kind of magical rift similar to that of Chaos Warp , or a time rift transited by a suspended creature.
Present debuted as a creature type imposed by Chaos Wrap , the 2022 Holiday card . That spell makes another card into a Present by putting it into play face down as a 4/4 red creature.
